Course topics include but not limited to project-based learning, process planning, problem solving, thread forming, coordinate rotation, multiple subprograms, type II roughing cycles, advanced G code programming, helical milling, fixture creation, datum shift, and more. Students will be prepared to acquire NIMS CNC credentials after completing the course.
